SELECT ?pt ?ptType ?tsid WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone .
  ?zone rdfs:label ?zlbl .
  FILTER(?zlbl IN ("Core_mid","Perimeter_mid_ZN_1","Perimeter_mid_ZN_2","Perimeter_mid_ZN_3","Perimeter_mid_ZN_4"))
  ?pt qudt:hasQuantityKind "https://qudt.org/vocab/quantitykind/ThermalTemperature" .
  ?pt brick:isPointOf ?zone .
  ?pt ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
  FILTER(?ptType="Air_Temperature_Sensor" || ?pt a brick:Air_Temperature_Sensor)
}
